title: Geography onboarding & prioritization ladder for region and data-residency requests
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Purpose: Create a clear, repeatable intake and prioritization ladder for non-bug customer requests related to region availability, data residency constraints, and failover topology. This ticket captures the product-side playbook: intake checklist, triage criteria, prioritization scoring, required artifacts, stakeholder routing rules, and the handoff to engineering/solutions for feasibility and cost estimation. Outcomes: (1) a one-page scoring matrix that converts legal/regulatory risk, ARR impact, latency/availability need, technical lift, and security profile into a single priority band; (2) a documented intake form for Sales/CS that enforces required artifacts; (3) clear SLAs for an initial feasibility response and estimate; (4) a routing map that specifies decisions that PM can make vs those requiring Security/Legal/Infra signoff. Acceptance criteria: the playbook is reviewed with Legal and Infra, the intake form is embedded into the CS intake workflow, and a pilot with two enterprise customers completes end-to-end within the defined SLAs.
